headline: Tenzing premieres on Apple TV+ with Tom Hiddleston and Willem Dafoe
summary: The new Apple Original Film, "Tenzing," is now available for subscribers to stream.
details: Apple TV+ has released its latest original film, "Tenzing." The movie stars Genden Phuntsok, Tom Hiddleston, and Willem Dafoe.
The film follows the true story of Tenzing Norgay, one of the first two individuals confirmed to have reached the summit of Mount Everest.
"Tenzing" is now available to stream for all Apple TV+ subscribers. A trailer for the film has also been released.

headline: Porsche previews new mid-engined supercar to rival 911
summary: Porsche has teased a new mid-engined supercar concept that could potentially sit above the iconic 911 in its lineup, hinting at a more extreme performance offering.
details: Porsche has unveiled a striking new mid-engined supercar concept, sparking speculation that it could be a successor to the legendary 911 or a new halo model for the brand.
The concept features a sleek, aerodynamic design with aggressive styling cues, including a prominent rear wing and large air intakes, suggesting a focus on track performance.

While official specifications are scarce, the mid-engine layout implies a significant departure from Porsche's traditional rear-engine 911, potentially offering a different driving dynamic and improved weight distribution.
This move could signal Porsche's ambition to push the boundaries of its sports car offerings, potentially competing with other high-performance supercars in the market.
Further details regarding the powertrain, performance figures, and potential production timeline are expected to be released in the coming months.
caption:
Porsche teases a radical new mid-engined supercar concept, potentially set to challenge the dominance of its own 911.

Porsche has unveiled a striking new mid-engined supercar concept, sparking speculation that it could be a successor to the legendary 911 or a new halo model for the brand.

The concept features a sleek, aerodynamic design with aggressive styling cues, including a prominent rear wing and large air intakes, suggesting a focus on track performance.

While official specifications are scarce, the mid-engine layout implies a significant departure from Porsche's traditional rear-engine 911, potentially offering a different driving dynamic and improved weight distribution.

This move could signal Porsche's ambition to push the boundaries of its sports car offerings, potentially competing with other high-performance supercars in the market.

Further details regarding the powertrain, performance figures, and potential production timeline are expected to be released in the coming months.
